nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Tampa, Florida. Half past two our time. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge, so it plays in the ESPN app instead of the channel list. It is the last game of the regular season. Tulane beat North Texas on Saturday to reach six wins and five losses, so the Green Wave is going to a bowl game. South Florida has won six games and lost five.

news.headline: Trace Johnson honored for his four touchdown passes
news.summary: The American Conference put the freshman quarterback on its weekly honor roll Monday. He completed 17 of his 21 throws for 283 yards and four touchdowns in Saturday's comeback win over North Texas.

news.headline: Tulane beats North Texas 28-24 and makes a bowl
news.summary: Trace Johnson threw four touchdown passes, and the last one, to Cameron Roberts with 2:13 left, put Tulane ahead for the first time. The Green Wave has won six games and lost five and is going to a bowl game for the fifth year in a row.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke is up for a national kicking award
news.summary: Tulane kicker Cooper Helmke is one of 20 players still in the running for the Lou Groza Award, which goes to the best kicker in the country. He has made 13 of his 15 field goals this year, and his longest was from 58 yards.

nextGame.note: Friday afternoon road game in Tallahassee against Florida State. Half past two our time, on Channel 26. It is the last game of the regular season and the oldest rivalry Florida has. Florida has won seven games and lost four after beating Vanderbilt on Saturday. Florida State has won five games and lost six.

news.headline: Vernell Brown will miss the Florida State game
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday night that the receiver's hurt knee will keep him out on Friday. It will be the eighth game Brown has missed this season.

news.headline: Myles Graham is a defensive player of the week
news.summary: The Southeastern Conference picked the Florida linebacker as one of its two best defenders of the week on Monday. He led the Gators with 10 tackles against Vanderbilt and ran a fumble back 57 yards for a touchdown.

news.headline: Florida moves up to 20th in the country
news.summary: The new Associated Press poll came out Sunday and Florida is 20th, up from 23rd. The win over Vanderbilt moved the Gators up three spots.

nextGame.note: Friday night road game at Texas A&M, the day after Thanksgiving. Half past six our time, on Channel 26. It is the last game of the regular season. Texas has won nine games and lost two after beating Arkansas 45-3 on Saturday. Texas A&M has won four games and lost seven.

news.headline: Arch Manning is the Manning Award star of the week
news.summary: The award named for his family picked him Monday for his day against Arkansas. He completed 15 of 17 passes for 230 yards, threw two touchdowns and ran for another one.

news.headline: Texas moves up to fifth in the country
news.summary: The new Associated Press poll came out Sunday and Texas is fifth, up from eighth. Three teams ahead of the Longhorns lost on Saturday.

news.headline: Texas runs over Arkansas 45-3
news.summary: Arch Manning threw for 287 yards and two touchdowns and ran for a third, completing 21 of his 25 passes. Texas led 31-3 at halftime and has now won five games in a row.

nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Cincinnati. Noon our time, on Channel 4. The Saints have won three games and lost seven after losing at Chicago 21-13 on Sunday. Cincinnati has the best passing offense in the league.

news.headline: Coach Moore says the close losses keep piling up
news.summary: Five of the seven Saints losses this year have been by a touchdown or less, including Sunday's 21-13 loss at Chicago. Coach Kellen Moore said Monday that his team keeps losing games that come down to a few plays.

news.headline: Juwan Johnson hurt his hamstring in Chicago
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said the tight end hurt his hamstring Sunday and did not finish the game. Moore said everyone else came out of the game all right.

news.headline: Chicago beats the Saints 21-13
news.summary: Chicago sacked Tyler Shough six times, once for a safety, and the Saints scored one touchdown, a one-yard catch by Alvin Kamara. New Orleans has now won three games and lost seven.

news.headline: IUP plays Wayne State on Thursday in Kansas City
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Gannon on Sunday to win their region, so they are one of the last eight teams playing for the national title. They play Wayne State College of Nebraska at half past one Thursday afternoon, our time, and the match is on ESPN+.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 8 kills in the regional final
news.summary: Peyton came off the bench Sunday against Gannon and hit 8 kills on 19 swings with one error. IUP was losing two sets to none when she went in, and won the match in five.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

nextGame.note: Baseball is finished until the spring. The Yankees open the new season at home against Toronto on Thursday, March 25, at twenty-five to one in the afternoon. No channel has been announced yet.

news.headline: The Yankees sign left-handed pitcher Brent Suter
news.summary: Suter agreed Monday to a one-year deal worth $4 million, with a club option for another season. He is 37 and had a 3.36 earned run average in 54 games last year for the Angels and the Braves.

news.headline: Paul Goldschmidt leaves the Yankees for the Mets
news.summary: The first baseman agreed Monday to a one-year deal with the Mets worth $8 million. He is 39 and played first base for the Yankees the past two seasons.

news.headline: The Yankees let go of Luis Gil and Fernando Cruz
news.summary: Both pitchers were cut loose Friday and can now sign with any team. Gil was the best rookie in the American League in 2024, but a sore shoulder cost him more than three months this past season.

news.headline: Evangel ends Warren Easton's season 52-14
news.summary: The Eagles lost Friday night in Shreveport in the first round of the state playoffs. Warren Easton finishes the year with four wins and seven losses.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.
